Use case: illustration-story. A finished wide landscape 16:9 page of a WORDLESS indie action-adventure game graphic novel, exactly three separately framed RECTANGULAR panels, no inset or extra frame. Thin black panel outlines, straight clean cream gutters 16–22 pixels, narrow cream margin. No visual element crosses a gutter. No text, letters, words, speech bubbles, numbers, watermark, page number or captions. Style across every page: grounded mature hand-inked color manga, beautiful deliberate tapered dark brush contours, confidently shaped solid shadows, cool midnight indigo / gray-blue moonlit color holds, low-saturation brown sand and dark teal water, selective warm color, a few disciplined screen tones. Bold clean shape readability, graphic economy. Warm materials remain subdued by night. Flat shadow steps; no fog bloom or cinematic gradients, stock concept-art finish, glossy render, pencil noise, exaggerated childlike faces, giant mountains or fantasy buildings. Environment is a small sacred lake in open desert dunes, a narrow teal ring of water with a low grassy center island, one tall leaning oak with sparse uneven branches, a pale knee-to-waist-high upright wedge stone with two smaller stones at its roots, sparse very thin upright poplars, two-tier rust sandstone slab just outside north edge, and near north waterline a low pale slanted rock with a small dark narrow-neck clay jug. Low silver fog stays around outer dry sand. Design sheet lock: fairy is an original young adult woman with plum dark-brown hair in a single high braided bun and one muted pink flower, garnet sleeveless fitted top, olive leaf skirt, brown boots, four thin BLUE dragonfly wings. Only two monsters: a broad adult dark bronze plated hooded caster with ochre scarf and a single small amber visor slit, and a wolf-sized pale ash-grey spider with compact low body, muted beige abdomen and eight long thin ash-white jointed legs. No extra monster or oversized spider. Magic colors remain differentiated: cool silver for barrier, dark purple for enemy spell and siphon, warm white-gold for fairy ritual vapor, cool blue/white for natural rain.
